name: Maid-san★Spirits! ~Watashi no Naka ni Iru Anata~
original_name: めいどさん★すぴりっつ！～わたしの中にいるあなた～
source:
Peck, who had been studying spirits, bought a house. There was a maid in this house named Fiena, who was a spirit. To analyze the mystery of spirits, he had sex with her every week.

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
一直潜心研究精灵的Peck买下了一栋房子。房子里住着一位名叫Fiena的女仆，她正是一位精灵。为了探究精灵的奥秘，他每周都与她发生关系。

[改编自ErogeShop]
